title: Duplex Model Heat Map
description: Loads the Duplex SceneModel + DataModel (~300 IFC objects) from its precomputed XGF + datamodel JSON, then uses applyHeatMapMaterials to bake a per-geometry heat-map texture (driven by vertex elevation along the worldUp axis) onto every triangle SceneObject. Click and drag to paint white onto whichever surface the cursor lands on — the change is fed into the renderer via texSubImage2D, no batch / mesh / material rebuild.
